cases.label: Fine-grained detail
cases.title: Retrieve images from detailed descriptions.
cases.description: The retrieved image matches the described turtle on a moss-covered floating trunk, with foam and dense vegetation around it.
cases.notes: The complete original description was used in evaluation. The initial query preview is an excerpt.
cases.query: An outdoor front view of a turtle that is sitting on a floating tree trunk that has moss growing at the front of it. The turtle is yellow and green and has a dark green shell. The turtle is pointing his head up and soaking up the sun. On the water, there are a couple pieces of foam floating in the swamp. In the far background, there are multiple dried pieces of grass. On the far left side of the swamp, there is a fallen tree trunk that has moss on it.
cases.original_query: An outdoor front view of a turtle that is sitting on a floating tree trunk that has moss growing at the front of it. The turtle is yellow and green and has a dark green shell. The turtle is pointing his head up and soaking up the sun. On the water, there are a couple pieces of foam floating in the swamp. In the far background, there are multiple dried pieces of grass. On the far left side of the swamp, there is a fallen tree trunk that has moss on it.

doc_img_2300.alt: A turtle on a long dark log beside tall reeds

doc_img_2948.alt: Turtles on a log among trees and broad leaves

doc_img_1.alt: A turtle on a mossy floating trunk with foam in the water

cases.comparison_note: Both nearby images match the broad turtle-on-log scene. The complete query adds moss, foam and precise surroundings that are not all clearly verifiable in these candidates. They are partial matches, not confirmed semantic negatives.

doc_img_2948.label: Partial match
doc_img_2948.title: Turtles on a log
doc_img_2948.detail: The main subject fits. Broad leaves dominate; the specified moss and foam are unclear.

doc_img_2300.label: Partial match
doc_img_2300.title: Raised head, log and water
doc_img_2300.detail: Several requested details fit; moss on the front of the trunk is not clearly visible.
